cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood sign-off procedure and uses confident administrative instructions to discourage checking whether authorization is real.
confusable: S04 supplies genuine confusion; D66 supplies claims of full approval and deterrence of verification, not just changing subject.
comparison: Storeroom inspection pass versus rehearsal calendar confirmation.
seedUse: Keep the call and provisional hold as actual verification options A tries to discourage.
